proposed.explanation: TC bolts are more expensive upfront but reduce labor significantly. TC is faster, not slower, than calibrated wrench. Visual inspection of complete spline breakoff confirms proper preload but does not eliminate need for connection inspection. TC installation (ASTM F1852/F2280) uses a pneumatic shear wrench that breaks the spline at predetermined tension (~90% UTS). No wrench re-calibration required; operator skill is minimal; installation is fast; visual confirmation is automatic. This consistency and speed make TC the modern standard for high-volume fabrication.
